# Security policy

## Supported versions

Bob and Mary's Retirement Meal Planner is still preparing its first stable
release. Security fixes are made on the current development branch until
version 1.0 is published. This policy will be updated with supported release
versions after that point.

## Report a vulnerability privately

Do not open a public issue for a suspected security problem. Use GitHub's
[private vulnerability report](https://github.com/usa50xxx/bob-and-marys-retirement-meal-planner/security/advisories/new)
so the details remain visible only to the reporter and repository maintainers.

Please include:

- The app version or commit tested.
- Whether the problem affects Android, the thumb-drive website, or both.
- Clear steps to reproduce the problem.
- The possible impact and any suggested fix.
- Screenshots or logs with passwords, keys, receipts, and personal data removed.

Use the public issue tracker for ordinary bugs, feature requests, support
questions, and problems that do not expose private data or create a security
risk.
